proposal.summary: Insecure direct object reference on /api/v2/orders/{id} allows an attacker to change the order id and retrieve other customers' orders including addresses.
proposal.cwe_quote: IDOR on /api/v2/orders/{id} - changing the id shows other customers' orders including addresses.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue by reproducing the request and confirm whether authentication is required; implement authorization checks to ensure the requesting user can only access their own orders, and consider logging and rotating any exposed PII.
